description: Open a page of the app in the review browser and wait for it to load. Use it to begin a walk on a given screen or to return to a known one. Returns the path now open, the HTTP status when the server answered an error, and any dialogs, blocked requests or JavaScript errors. Pages on other sites are refused.

path.description: Path such as /pricing or /flows?tab=draft, or a full URL on the app's own origin.

name: open
